description: This file defines the ADODB2_oci8 class, a specialized data dictionary implementation for Oracle's oci8 driver within the ADOdb database abstraction library. It contains methods for translating data types, creating and modifying database schemas, handling sequences/triggers for auto-increment emulation, and managing SQL statements specific to Oracle.

classes.name: ADODB2_oci8
classes.description: A data dictionary class for Oracle oci8 driver, providing methods for type conversion, schema operations, and trigger/sequence management tailored for Oracle databases.

methods.name: metaType
methods.description: Converts PHP data types to Oracle-specific data type abbreviations.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal type codes back to Oracle data types.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to create a new Oracle user/schema with optional tablespace.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to add columns to an existing table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to alter existing table columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _DropAutoIncrement
methods.description: Generates SQL to drop sequence used for auto-increment emulation.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Creates SQL suffixes for column definitions, including defaults and not-null constraints.

methods.name: _Triggers
methods.description: Creates Oracle sequences and triggers to emulate auto-increment functionality.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for creating or replacing indexes with options such as BITMAP or UNIQUE.

methods.name: GetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to retrieve comments on a column.

methods.name: SetCommentSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL to set a comment on a column.
